notes: Encoded ONLY from this brand's own page. Page header lists Artic Circle, Champion, Champion Cooler, Essick Air, MasterCool, MoistAir, Spec-Air and UltraCool, but the page body describes Champion Cooler brand equipment and does not state those brands share these serial systems, so no sisters are claimed and nothing is imported from the Champion or Essick Air files. Page parent line: Champion Cooler, a subsidiary company of Essick Air Products, Inc.

styles.notes: Page positions 2nd & 3rd numerical digits = year (1-based characters 2-3, converted to 0-based half-open [1,3] -> '07' -> 2007). Character counting ships: the page's 'numerical digits' wording is read as digit characters at those positions, matching the already-shipped Champion/Essick Air precedent for this same example and the falsification proof on the Nordyne-family pages (digit-only subsequence counting gives an impossible year there). Digit-only subsequence counting would give '71' -> 1971; that alternative is recorded here, not encoded. Month = 1st letter digit per page text, but its letter-to-month mapping lives only in chart image Champion_Essick-Air_Spec-Air-Serial-Number-Style-1_How-to-determine-the-date-of-manufacture-or-age.png, so month is null and the style ships year-only pending the image pass.
